output.population: 134 cases from intensive care unit and emergency department settings, with patient-initiated questions drawn from real-world health forum messages aligned to publicly accessible real EHRs.
output.summary: Expert-annotated question answering dataset pairing patient-initiated questions with clinician-interpreted questions, sentence-level relevance annotations over EHR excerpts, and clinician-written free-text answers grounded in those sentences, plus an evaluation framework.
